title: Shopper Pay Schedule Note — The Cartwise Shopper Batches Long-Distance Bonus
content:
**Clause.** The long-distance bonus on a completed batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches is one flat amount, the batch type's long-distance bonus, paid when the batch type's long-distance threshold is above zero and the estimated route shown on the offer exceeds that threshold. The distance compared is the estimated route, never the miles driven. The bonus is rounded to the cent half up and posted once on the batch.

## The clause taken apart

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Amount | The batch type's long-distance bonus, one flat amount |
| When it is due | The batch type's long-distance threshold is above zero **and** the estimated route shown on the offer is greater than that threshold |
| Distance used | The estimated route on the offer; the GPS miles driven play no part |
| Rounding | To the cent, half up |
| Posting | Once on the batch |

Both parts of the "when it is due" test must hold. A route exactly equal to the threshold does not exceed it.

## Truth table

| Threshold above zero | Estimated route greater than the threshold | Long-distance bonus |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The batch type's long-distance bonus |
| Yes | No | None |
| No | (any route) | None |

## Worked figures (hypothetical batch type)

A hypothetical batch type carries a long-distance bonus of 2.40 and a threshold of 12.0 miles (figures chosen for illustration, not schedule values).

- Estimated route 12.6 miles, 18.2 miles driven: 12.6 exceeds 12.0, so the bonus is 2.40.
- Estimated route 12.0 miles, 15.0 miles driven: 12.0 does not exceed 12.0, so no bonus is due, however far the shopper drove.
- A batch type whose threshold is 0.0 pays no long-distance bonus on any route.
